text:
Claire: Quick sync: need to lock DP pilot selection criteria + feedback cadence for next cohort. Who can join?
Sam: I can. we have 6 seats, want a final rubric today.
Anya: +1, and Ill flag accounts that need NDAs/KMS early.
Micah: Ill prepare the eval prompt set and share infra checks.
Claire: Proposal: 6 pilots = mix of 2 enterprise, 2 mid-market SaaS, 2 AI-native startups. Criteria: impact, engagement likelihood, data sensitivity, integration effort.
Sam: Share quick scoring matrix here so we can score candidates consistently.
Claire: ```Selection scoring (raw): Use-case fit 0-5 | Engagement bandwidth 0-3 | Data sensitivity 0-2 (higher=more restrictive) | Integration effort 0-2 (lower better)```
Anya: Recommend weighting Use-case fit x2 at rank stage. Also prefer customers with clear retention upside.
Micah: Can we require a lightweight eval harness up front? 1 week, 10 representative calls to get realistic latency/quality reads.
Sam: Note on capacity: Dedicated can handle 4 heavy-throughput pilots simultaneously. >4 needs reserved commit. Private/on-prem adds ~2w to timeline.
Claire: Pilot -> beta promotion criteria (draft): quality gates: pass 3/5 eval prompts w/no regressions; latency p95 < 450ms streaming; cost projection < $X per 1M tokens; ops: alerts + runbook in Console.
Sam: Also require rollback + fallback model (hosted cheaper variant) configured for all pilots.
Anya: Feedback loop: weekly syncs + async NPS pulse + 3-question milestone form. Pilot length: 6 weeks with checkpoints at 2w/4w/6w.
Claire: Add two tracks in IO template: "integration-lite" (no infra changes, limited observability) vs "full partner" (dedicated KPIs, deeper tracing). Use these to set scope and SLAs.
Micah: Will publish eval harness repo link and sample prompts by EOD, including metrics JSON for automated checks.
Claire: Owners: Sam -> capacity & fallback config; Anya -> recruitment & legal intake; Micah -> eval harness; Claire -> shortlist + IO templates.
Sam: Heads-up: heavy Private enterprise in this cohort means we should swap one startup to next cohort.
Anya: I'll surface 3 strong candidates + legal/KMS notes by EOD.
Claire: Plan: score candidates with rubric+weights by Friday; finalize cohort Monday; outreach starts Tuesday. If anyone misses scoring ping me to reassign. :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: Reminder: new Dedicated pool request template updated: https://redwood.internal/dedicated-pools
Claire: Thanks all. If blockers appear Ill run a 15m alignment call tomorrow morning.
